nodes.label: Controlled migration runner
nodes.rationale: 4. Rehearse Alembic **0016–0023** with representative existing data. Verify substitutions, precision, revisions, replay receipts, source integrity and price indexes. Measure DDL lock/build time; use one controlled migration runner. Do not scale Compose's current API-startup migration pattern to multiple replicas. 5. Rehearse rollback compatibility. Older downgrade paths deliberately refuse to discard recorded substitutions, precision or integrity data. A code rollback may require a compatible schema or forward repair; do not assume every downgrade is safe. 6. Run guarded disposable local engine tests, then equivalent races in isolated Supabas

nodes.label: Coordinated database-object recovery
nodes.rationale: Supabase Database backups/PITR alone are not a coordinated recovery of records, source objects, custom JWT/session state and external payment effects. Complete the [R6 recovery procedure](audits/2026-10-26/R6_SOURCE_STORAGE.md) with verified DB/object manifests, release/configuration metadata, encrypted off-site copies and timed isolated restore drills. Freeze writers/GC while constructing or restoring a recovery set. Reconcile externally cleared payments before reopening writes. Assign ownership and business-approved RPO/RTO and availability targets, then measure them. Include failed releases/migrations, Storage/database outages, damaged obj

nodes.label: Durable-key retention
nodes.rationale: Implement the [R8 retention plan](audits/2026-10-26/R8_READ_SCALING.md#retention-and-archive-plan) before archive/deletion jobs. Durable keys must retain their versioned payload identity and replay outcome/tombstone; expired keys must never become new executable writes. Preserve financial/audit/source relationships. No automatic archive, purge or key expiry is implemented today. ## Monitoring and deployment work

nodes.label: Business policy approval
nodes.rationale: Admin/finance must review the [13 legacy ended-price candidates](audits/2026-10-26/LEGACY_PRICE_REVIEW.md); no bulk correction occurred. R9 now supports stage-aware operational closure. Customers do not use this system; payments, refunds, credits and receipts are explicitly excluded. The team handles everything after final invoice creation externally. Do not invent fulfilment, silently change issued invoices or promise new offline/tenant/external-payment behavior without its failure design.
